method: Warren/Wood/Vawter use separately constrained, midpoint-refined roof plans inset 0.3m and simplified 0.55m solely to smooth GIS digitization steps. Height follows a near-linear distance-to-roof-boundary profile normalized by sampled inradius, yielding estimated ridge planes without broad flat caps. Structural shells remain on the exact GIS ring. FID66 retains its previous low roof form because its subgrade relationship is unresolved.
